changelog: AGY Hub auto-starts in the background on app launch without blocking the bridge API or shutdown
Fixed 'text file busy' security-header patch failure when restarting while an old AGY process is still running
Added automatic AGY Hub restart with exponential backoff (2s-30s, max 5 attempts) after unexpected crashes
Hub readiness timeout and early process exit now surface clear errors with captured logs instead of staying stuck
Added automatic local bridge restart after unexpected exits (user stop is not restarted)
Fixed stale CSRF token causing MCP servers and RPC calls to fail after a hub restart (auto refresh + one retry)
Increased localhost health-check timeouts so a busy proot rootfs is not reported offline
Restored the termux rootfs download URL broken during rebranding
